name: get_asset_dependencies
purpose: On-disk dependency list of a package with hard/soft/game/build edge classification — graph data find_assets lacks.
cooked: degraded — container packages have dependency graph stripped at cook; self-diagnose, never silent-empty
hazards: Must set dependencyDataAvailable:false for container-only packages, never silent-empty

name: get_asset_referencers
purpose: Reverse edge: what references this asset, incl. which loose project assets reference a base-game container asset.
cooked: degraded — loose-to-container edges survive; container-side referencers stripped, note in response
hazards: Container-side referencers invisible (stripped at cook) — response must carry note

name: find_assets_by_tag
purpose: Query registry by asset-registry tag/value pairs (e.g. DataTables by RowStructure) — axis find_assets cannot express.
cooked: works — cooked registries carry tags; editor-only tags may be stripped, counts make absence measurable

name: get_asset_tags
purpose: Dump the full asset-registry tag/value map for one asset without loading it.
cooked: works — honest source of truth for what metadata survived the cook

name: get_class_hierarchy
purpose: Registry-level class inheritance: all classes derived from X (incl. unloaded cooked BPGCs) and ancestor chain of X.
cooked: works — inheritance map includes container BPGCs never loaded; headline cooked win
hazards: Can be slow if temporary caching mode is not on (header :424/:431) — single pass, same-frame

name: resolve_redirector
purpose: Chase ObjectRedirectors to the live object path at registry level, no load — fixes stale paths after rename_asset.
cooked: works — cooked content rarely contains redirectors; mostly relevant to loose assets
prevents: Stale-path confusion after rename_asset feeding every objectPath endpoint

name: list_content_paths
purpose: Enumerate the content folder tree (registry-cached paths) — answers 'what folders exist under /Game'.
cooked: works — mounted container content contributes registry paths

name: get_package_disk_data
purpose: Per-package physical data from the registry — disk size, file version, imported classes, extension — no filesystem touch.
cooked: degraded — package data only updated on save; mounted cooked registries may omit it, report available:false

name: create_asset
purpose: Mint non-Blueprint assets (DataTable, curves, DataAssets, StringTable, MPC, PhysicalMaterial, AnimBlueprint) via factory allowlist.
cooked: n/a — creates loose project assets only; cooked skeleton/struct can be referenced
hazards: CanCreateAsset opens FMessageDialog modals on invalid names and YesNo replace prompt (AssetTools.cpp:4287-4332)
Must pre-validate names + registry existence BEFORE calling; overwrite via delete_asset, never engine prompt
UAnimBlueprintFactory opens FMessageDialog on bad ParentClass (AnimBlueprintFactory.cpp:454-459) — pre-validate
Must not sit in blanket transaction — delete-on-undo of fresh package is documented crash shape
Without pre-validation risk reads R2 not R3

name: import_asset
purpose: Import a disk file (PNG/TGA to Texture2D, FBX to meshes, WAV to SoundWave) as a project asset.
cooked: n/a — always creates loose assets; refuse destinations colliding with container-only packages
hazards: GetObjects() blocks until async results ready (doc :78) — never call before IsAsyncImportComplete
Always set Task->Factory explicitly or PNG/FBX may route to async Interchange (AssetTools.cpp:3068-3071)
bAutomated=true required — sets GIsRunningUnattendedScript guard suppressing dialogs (AssetTools.cpp:3045)
Non-modal FScopedSlowTask progress dialog appears (AssetTools.cpp:2485-2486) — acceptable, one long frame
Must not be inside the blanket transaction

name: export_asset
purpose: Write an asset to a disk file (texture to PNG, mesh to OBJ/FBX, sound to WAV, object/level to T3D) for outside diffing.
cooked: works — textures/meshes generally export; T3D of cooked BPs mostly useless (graphs stripped)
hazards: Prompts gated on Task->bPrompt (UnrealExporter.cpp:337/:385) — handler must set bPrompt=false, bAutomated=true

name: validate_assets
purpose: Run the engine data-validation pass over chosen assets, returning structured per-asset errors/warnings.
cooked: degraded — container assets validate against cooked form; stripped BP graphs validate vacuously, report origin
hazards: FScopedSlowTask ForceVisible + MakeDialogDelayed pumps Slate mid-frame (EditorValidatorSubsystem.cpp:218-220) — keep lists small
Set bShowIfNoFailures=false or toast notifications spawn (EditorValidatorSubsystem.h:95)

name: map_check
purpose: Run the editor's Map Check over the loaded level and return the message list structurally.
cooked: works — checks loaded level actors regardless of origin; cooked maps checkable, not saveable
hazards: Map_Check is PRIVATE on UEditorEngine (EditorEngine.h:2544) — direct call does not compile; use Exec route
Without DONTDISPLAYDIALOG a modal appears; exec flag suppresses it
Non-cancellable GWarn->BeginSlowTask during run (EditorServer.cpp:3954)
bClearLog starts a new MapCheck log page — readback must take the CURRENT page only

name: get_message_log
purpose: Read any FMessageLog channel (MapCheck, AssetCheck, LoadErrors, BlueprintLog, PIE, ...) as structured JSON.
cooked: works — logs are session state, not assets
hazards: GetLogListing silently CREATES an empty listing for unknown names (MessageLogModule.h:52) — gate on IsRegisteredLogListing
GetFilteredMessages returns current page's view — pair with map_check bClearLog/new-page semantics

name: list_dirty_packages
purpose: Enumerate unsaved (dirty) content and world packages before save_package / trigger_cook / PIE.
cooked: works — dirtied container-backed packages flagged saveable:false (can never be saved)

name: get_asset_compilation_status
purpose: Poll outstanding async asset compilation (textures, meshes, sounds) — the missing poll half for import_asset and bulk mutation.
hazards: Never call FinishAllCompilation (:133) from a handler — frame-blocking drain of the whole queue

name: fixup_redirectors
purpose: Repoint all referencers of ObjectRedirectors at live assets and delete the redirectors.
cooked: degraded — loose-only; container referencers reported unfixable with origin listed
hazards: Blocking SDiscoveringAssetsDialog if registry still scanning (AssetFixUpRedirectors.cpp:59-66) — gate on IsLoadingAssets
ObjectTools::DeleteObjects retains modal failure paths (ObjectTools.cpp:2833/:3127) — residual modal risk
Must pass bCheckoutDialogPrompt=false; save leg is prompt-free (bPromptToSave=false confirmed)

name: consolidate_assets
purpose: Merge duplicate assets: repoint every referencer of N sources at one target and optionally delete the sources.
cooked: degraded — sources loose-only; target may be container asset; container-only referencers unrewritable, report
hazards: 3-arg overload defaults bWarnAboutRootSet=true — rooted object triggers modal YesNo (ObjectTools.cpp:1093-1110)
UNSUPPRESSABLE end-of-run failure modals gated only by !IsRunningCommandlet() (ObjectTools.cpp:1440/:1888/:1922)
Mandatory pre-validation ladder: same-class, target not depending on sources, no rooted sources, sources deletable
API performs NO type checking by design (header note :217)
R2 justified only WITH the pre-validation ladder; critical-failure modal remains residual risk
